company.shortDescription: Measured is the pioneer and leader of incrementality-based media measurement and optimization.
company.description: Measured is the pioneer and leader of incrementality-based media measurement and optimization. Since 2017, leading brands have used our AI-powered, all-in-one platform to manage, test, plan, and optimize over $20 billion in full-funnel media investments. Measured’s unique combination of automated experimentation, media mix modeling, and industry-leading expertise helps marketers prove the incremental impact of their advertising and maximize ROI with unmatched ease, accuracy, and efficiency.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $21,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $152,899,516 to $152,899,516, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 79 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 77 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
